description.zh:
子域参数。

参数格式为：
```
Subdomains: [
    "subdomain-test"
]
```
description.en:
The subdomain parameters.

The format is as follows:

```
Subdomains: [
    "subdomain-test"
]
```

descriptions.zh:
- 子域名称全局唯一，不同的RAM用户也不允许创建相同的子域。
 - API调用频率：100次/秒。
descriptions.en:
- Each subdomain must be globally unique across all RAM users.

- API call frequency: 100 calls per second.
